name: subcontractor_engaged_for_cbtc_radio_network
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-85, from Run 44919705575: Fortress Solutions, Mass Transit): a named company is engaged as a subcontractor to provide the radio network of a metro line's CBTC signalling project.

candidates.title: Company to provide wireless network for metro line CBTC project
candidates.search_snippet: Company to provide wireless network for metro line CBTC project.
candidates.source_content: The network company has been engaged by the signalling contractor to design, supply and integrate the dedicated wireless network that will carry train-to-wayside communication for the communications-based train control system on the metro line. The work is part of the line's signalling modernization project. The company will install radio equipment along the line and in its stations.
